nodes.name: deploy.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that, on push to master, installs pnpm dependencies, runs spellcheck and lint, builds the admin app, and deploys apps/admin/dist to GitHub Pages.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-job pipeline: build uploads ./apps/admin/dist via actions/upload-pages-artifact, then deploy uses actions/deploy-pages with the github-pages environment.
